review_basis: Fixed two-condition design communicated by the parent agent; no protocol or runtime source has been reviewed for this point.
allowed_next_scope: Independent implementation and one complete source review
One necessary tiny synthetic admission check after source acceptance

conditions.KeepGate: Keep original dense gate and down; replace only up by independent rank-200 square-root SVD factors.
conditions.KeepUp: Keep original dense up and down; replace only gate by independent rank-200 square-root SVD factors.
conditions.common: Same fresh original OneVision base, full vision/attention/embedding/projector and down weights; FP32 SVD initialization cast to FP16; frozen compression factors; identical q/v rank-8 adaptation on original 1213 FIT / 19 stages / 87 updates.
conditions.physical_representation: No dense residual, original replaced matrix, or original SVD basis retained in the final model. Fairly fold q/v into attention weights and save a complete reloadable checkpoint.

design_counts_not_measured.actual_layout_aliases_buffers_and_packag: Pending independent implementation verification; these counts are not measured model or package results.

evaluation_scope.scoring: Original Answer F1, once per new prediction record; no rescoring of old anchors.
evaluation_scope.DEV_status: Previously explored DEV, not a new independent holdout.
evaluation_scope.continue_only_if: KeepGate final macro strictly exceeds KeepUp final macro and the fixed legal wide-qv anchor, with actual complete weight reduction verified.
evaluation_scope.otherwise: Close this fixed role/rank point; no automatic rank, learning-rate, recovery, or extra-condition search.

findings: Compressing only one branch removes the common low-rank down bottleneck from the proposed role comparison and reduces the chance that both conditions reach a shared quality floor.
Gate and up have equal original shapes, so the exchanged dense-versus-rank200 allocation has exactly matched weight counts. All other architecture and adaptation choices can be shared.
The original three-projection rank200 result and LoRA placement comparisons do not answer this exchanged-role question.
A favorable result can select preservation of the original gate projection for subsequent compact-method design; uncertainty about the result does not invalidate this fixed exploration.
required_implementation_controls: Bind the same original base and identical unchanged down/other weights; preserve identical q/v initial parameters, sample order, training RNG policy and adaptation recipe between conditions.
Record initial and final scores separately. Keep final and initial role differences visible; do not label their difference as isolated learning ability.
Bind all datasets, references, input and score helpers; freeze exact budgets, lifecycle and failure rules before model admission.
Verify actual final complete weight/storage accounting with shared storage deduplicated and required buffers included, and verify complete checkpoint reload before final evaluation.
limitations: Frozen compression factors with q/v-only adaptation test retained pretrained representations under subsequent common attention adaptation; they do not test direct gate or up trainability.
Keeping gate weights does not keep actual gate responses fixed because upstream hidden inputs can change.
Unequal initial function damage is part of the structural intervention, so endpoint superiority does not isolate nonlinear gating geometry from compression approximation or optimization effects.
The PAS selection/response argument is a motivation, not a demonstrated local causal mechanism transferred by this intervention.

Failure closes this fixed point only, not all gate-retention structures or all ranks. A positive single-seed explored-DEV point is not stable superiority, a new framework, or automatic full confirmation.
This is a new single-branch structural contrast, not restoration of any closed rank200 checkpoint or worker.
No Torch, synthetic gate, data consumption, model, prediction, scoring or activation was executed in this review.
protocol_binding_scope: Incremental binding of the accepted single-branch role comparison to its actual protocol, including continuous q/v, common HostAdamW/CPU saved-tensor offload, 500 new DEV generations, and 1800+3600+3600-second model ceilings. No new scientific condition.
common_implementation_policy: Both arms use the same existing HostAdamW and CPU saved-tensor offload. This does not assert bitwise equivalence to all historical runs.
